before.gpi_chain_links_rationale: No reaction made GlcNAc-PI (m596), so the GPI chain had no entry. UDP-GlcNAc and UDP are the cytosolic species with formulas (m403, m11); PI is the ER-membrane pool (m1648, made by R1839). The 2 H+ reconcile the stored charges (UDP-GlcNAc -2, UDP 0); KEGG does not balance protons. Irreversible: glycosyl transfer from a nucleotide sugar.

after.gpi_chain_links_rationale: No reaction made GlcNAc-PI (m596), so the GPI chain had no entry. UDP-GlcNAc and UDP are the cytosolic species with formulas (m403, m11); PI is the ER-membrane pool (m1648, made by R1839).
